svg.title: BIST30 Portföy Optimizasyonu
svg.desc: Postcard for BIST30 Portföy Optimizasyonu (thesis · flask web app, Python): Forecasts return and risk for BIST 30 stocks and builds optimal portfolios. ARIMA, GARCH, Black–Litterman and LSTM forecasts. Monte Carlo portfolios for three risk profiles. Weekly forecasts, macro signals, user vs AI board. Built with Python, Flask, TensorFlow, pmdarima, arch, scikit-learn, Plotly, SQLite.
